context_for_next_testing_agent: Device Owner mode feature fully implemented and tested. Key endpoints: POST /api/clients/{id}/generate-code?lock_mode=device_owner|device_admin generates 9-char or 8-char codes respectively. POST /api/device/register determines lock_mode from code length (8=device_admin, 9=device_owner). GET /api/device/status/{id} returns ClientStatusResponse with lock_mode, outstanding_balance, monthly_emi fields. Frontend is a React Native (Expo) app and cannot be tested via browser.
